_comment: Two issues that each own SEVERAL files, listed in the body in an order that is not their sorted order. The single-file fixtures cannot tell a deterministic contract generator from a non-deterministic one — a one-element list survives any shuffle — so the contract determinism case (#1588) uses this one instead.

issues.title: feat: add a session store
issues.body:
Add the session store across `src/store/write.ts`, `src/store/index.ts` and `src/store/read.ts`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `src/store/write.ts` persists a session
- [ ] `src/store/read.ts` returns the last write

## Dependencies
- Depends on #211

issues.title: feat: add base configuration loader
issues.body:
Add the base configuration loader across `src/config/schema.ts`, `src/config/base.ts` and `src/config/env.ts`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `src/config/base.ts` reads config from disk
- [ ] `src/config/env.ts` overlays environment values
